page.layout: Two columns of entries on one printed page, read left column then right column. Page number at top left. Running head at top, Hebrew letter headings. Left column: entries from "סָבַב" onward. Right column: entries from "סָג" onward, then the section letter "ס ד" and its entries. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: derunt me, præt. Kal, 3. pl. aff. Rad. סָבַב.
סְבּוֹתִי circumdedi, præt. Kal, 1. f. R. סָבַב.
סָבִיב circuitus, סְבִיבִי circuitus, pl. סְבִיבָיו.
סְבִיבוֹתָיו ejus, &c. No. f. & pl. m. & f. aff. Rad. סָבַב circuivit.
סֹבִּי circui, circuite, Imp. Kal, f. f. & pl. m. Rad. סָבַב.
מִ־סִּבְכּוֹ à perplexitate sua, No. f. m. סָבָךְ perplexi-tas, præf. aff. Rad. סָבַךְ implexum esse.
סְבֻלוֹת onera, pl. fæm. No. f. f. סְבֻלָה, Rad. סָבַל portavit.
סִבֹּלֶת spica, pro שִׁבֹּלֶת, No. sing. fæm. Rad. שָׁבַל.
סְבַּתִּי circumdedi, סְבַּתֶּם circumdedistis, præt. Kal, 1. f. & 2. pl. m. Rad. סָבַב.
סָג retrocessit, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. R. סוּג.
לְסִגִים in scorias, No. pl. m. præf. à f. m. No. Rad. סוּג.
לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ in peculium suum, sing. fæm. aff. No. Rad. סְגֻלָּה, constr. סְגֻלַּת, R. inusit. סגל.
סְגָנִים antistites, No. pl. m. à f. m. No. Rad. סגן.
סָגַר clauditur, סָגְרוּ occlu-duntur, Præt. Pual, 3. f. m. & 3. pl. Rad. סָגַר.
סַגְרִיר imber vehemens, No. f. m. Rad. סָגַר clausit.
בְּסַד in compede, No. Rad. סַד, præf.
סְדִינִים sindones, No. pl. m. à f. m. סָדִין, Rad. סָדַן.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks in the small type are hard to read at this scan resolution; some Hebrew forms are transcribed from the best reading and may contain errors. The right-hand running head letters and the section letters are uncertain. The Hebrew word after "pro" in the spica entry is a doubtful reading.
